Name: Adah, Wife of Esau
Summary: Adah was a wife of Esau, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and the mother of Eliphaz.
KeyStory: Adah's son Eliphaz fathered the dukes of Edom, so her line became the firstborn line of Esau's house.
RelatedPeople: Esau; Elon, Father of Adah; Eliphaz, Son of Esau
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
